concerns.text: Task T042 is tagged as [FR‑007] (runtime‑budget enforcement) but its deliverable (quantization calibration) does not enforce or verify the runtime‑budget constraints required by FR‑007, resulting in a traceability mismatch and a semantic weakening of the requirement.

The identifier T004 is used for two distinct tasks ("Add .ruff.toml and pyproject.toml" in Phase 1 and "Config module" in Phase 2). Duplicate task IDs break traceability and can cause orphaned or untracked work, violating the project's reproducibility and version‑discipline principles.
